name: everest-south-col-expedition
description: Browser mountaineering simulator of the Everest–Lhotse massif on the 4 m Pléiades terrain (Three.js).

scripts.start:offline: node -e "console.log('Open http://localhost:8080/?localthree (three.js served from node_modules)')" && http-server -c-1 -p 8080 .
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/harness.mjs tests/terrain.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/hazards.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/ui.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/debrief.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/freeview.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/memorials.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/extras.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/expedition.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/expedition_lhotse.json && node tests/harness.mjs tests/expedition_nuptse.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
